title: 11 Kitchen Tools That Speed Up Prep for Large Party Buffets
meta_description: Discover 11 essential kitchen tools that speed up prep for large party buffet kitchen tools, from mandolines to vertical gyro pans and more.
html:
When you’re feeding a crowd, every minute counts. The right large party buffet kitchen tools can turn a chaotic prep line into a smooth operation. Below are eleven pieces of gear that I rely on whenever I’m staging a buffet for 30‑plus guests. Each item cuts down on time, reduces waste, and keeps the kitchen running like a well‑oiled machine.

1. Slice and Dice Faster with a Mandoline and Herb Scissors

A mandoline slicer is a buffet‑essential for producing uniform, restaurant‑thin slices of carrots, cucumbers, onions, and cheese in seconds. The adjustable blades let you switch from julienne to waffle cuts without swapping tools. Pair it with a set of herb scissors – the five‑blade design lets you mince cilantro, basil, or chives in a single snip, eliminating the need for a separate knife and cutting board.

2. Keep Onions, Tomatoes, and Potatoes Steady with an Onion Holder & Slicing Guide

Even‑sized pieces make a buffet look professional and help guests serve themselves quickly. The stainless‑steel onion holder and slicing guide securely clamps the produce, so you can glide a knife across without wobbling. It also doubles as a meat tenderizer, giving you two jobs in one sturdy tool.

3. Bulk‑Prep Garlic and Avocados Without the Hassle

Garlic presses crush dozens of cloves in a single squeeze, turning them into a smooth paste that mixes evenly into dressings or marinades. For avocado prep, the 3‑in‑1 avocado slicer splits, pits, and slices the fruit in one motion, preventing the dreaded knife‑to‑hand accidents that slow down assembly lines.

4. Streamline Dough and Bread Work with the 3‑in‑1 Sourdough Whisk Set

If you’re baking fresh rolls or focaccia for the buffet, the Danish‑style dough whisk mixes starter and flour without a mess, while the scraper scrapes the bowl clean. The included lame lets you score loaves quickly for a professional finish. For a lighter alternative, the Wooden Spurtle & Sourdough Starter Stirrer Set (2 PCS) offers a skinny spurtle for gentle folding and a dough stick for jar‑scraping.

5. Cook Large Quantities Efficiently with a Vertical Gyro Pan and Interlocking Corn Holders

The vertical gyro pan with skewer is perfect for roasting gyros, al pastor tacos, or kebabs in the oven. Its vertical orientation maximizes surface area, allowing you to cook multiple skewers at once while the juices drip back into the pan for extra flavor. When it comes to corn on the cob, the interlocking corn on the cob holders (5 pairs) keep each ear upright and organized, making it easy to grill or boil a full tray without a single cob rolling off the rack.

6. Serve Drinks and Garnishes with Flair

Party drinks need more than just ice. The 150‑Pack Cocktail Drink Umbrellas & Picks adds a splash of color to margaritas, piña coladas, and mocktails, while the 100‑Pack Umbrella Straws combine a straw and a mini parasol for a playful touch. For a cheeky party gag, the extendable prank fork (2‑Pack, extends to 25.4 in) provides endless laughs and a quick way to retrieve a stuck bite.

7. Finish the Buffet with Precise Temperature Control and Clean‑Up Tools

An instant‑read meat thermometer ensures every roast, chicken wing, or kebab hits the perfect internal temperature, eliminating guesswork and reducing overcooking. After the feast, silicone baking mats replace parchment and make cleanup a breeze—just pull them out, wash, and reuse. A sturdy jar & bottle opener tackles stubborn lids, and a pizza cutter wheel slices through flatbreads or pre‑baked pizza without dragging.

8. Handy Extras That Save Time

  • Garlic press – crushes cloves in seconds.
  • Avocado slicer – split, pit, and slice in one motion.
  • Spice & pepper grinder – freshly cracked flavor on demand.
  • Cookie dough scoop – uniform portions for mini desserts.
  • Vegetable spiralizer – turn veggies into low‑carb noodles.

These tools aren’t just nice‑to‑have; they’re the kind of large party buffet kitchen tools that keep you moving from prep to plating without missing a beat.

FAQ

What is the best way to slice large quantities of vegetables for a buffet?

Use a mandoline slicer for uniform thickness and combine it with herb scissors for quick chopping of herbs. This combo speeds up prep and ensures a consistent presentation.

How can I keep corn on the cob organized while cooking?

Interlocking corn on the cob holders keep each ear upright and prevent them from rolling around. They also make transfer from pot to serving tray effortless.

Do I really need a vertical gyro pan for a home buffet?

If you’re serving gyro‑style meats or kebabs, the vertical gyro pan maximizes oven space and allows juices to baste the meat as it cooks, delivering flavor and efficiency that a flat pan can’t match.
